Nisha bhagat maut mamle ki sibiaaee janch ki mang ko lekar aandolan kar rahi bijepi ne mukhyamantri hemant soren ke dvara biti rat soshal midiya ke jarie sibiaaee janch karae jane ke nirnay par sandeh vyakt kiya. bhajpa ne kaha hai ki jab tak is sanbandh men anushansa nahin ki jati tab tak is sanbandh men kahna mushkil hai.
